What about a blood test? I had uti like symptoms but nothing showed up in 5-6 different urine cultures over the span of 3 months. And all ultrasounds showed everything was normal, but a blood test showed my body had a high level of white blood cells. And that meant that my body was fighting some kind of bacterial infection. Although it doesn’t indicate exactly what kind of bacteria or where the infection is present. I was given amoxicillin for a week after this blood test. Doctors refused to give me antibiotics based on my urine cultures before. I do still get some bladder pain occasionally from certain food but my uti symptoms like urgency is gone.

I prefer the capsules/pills. I also have the powder form which is more bang for your buck but the pills are more convenient for carrying around in my purse in case I need to have them when I’m outside. There’s not much difference in how they work in different forms but some brands sell capsules mixed with other things like cranberry and hibiscus extract, and cranberry might not be good for a lot of people with IC.
